_comment: Room tone profiles (OFFICE_LIFE_PLAN 12.6, slice 20). Read by systems/office-room-tone.js (fetched at install) and scripts/validate_npc_needs.rb. Only a scenario with "roomTone": true uses them. A room's exact type picks its profile (types); a scenario maps bespoke types with roomToneTypes. bed: the loop played in that room (at level x the ambient volume) when the room authors no ambientSound of its own; null for a quiet room. typing: the typing loop plays while seated NPCs in the room work. spots: one-shots the background scheduler may play (copier_run only in a room with a copier, distant_phone never in a room with a desk phone). Profile beds never bleed into a neighbouring room.
